canonical-json.rule: project dynamic fields, parse JSON, compare semantic tree; tool arguments parse then canonicalize

exact-allowed-token-set.rule: allowed next byte/token set equal; ordering ignored

exact-token-ids.rule: integer token vector equal; detokenized bytes equal input bytes

fork-specific.rule: evaluate only for declared candidate; other candidates reject or are not applicable

gguf-structural.rule: container fields, metadata, type IDs, dimensions, alignment, and tensor byte ranges equal

json-boundary-validity.rule: all incomplete cuts reject; complete record accepts

numeric-probabilities.rule: token order exact when present; probabilities abs(error)<=1e-5; rtol=0

numeric_f32_restore.rule: same continuation token IDs; logits abs(error)<=1e-5; rtol=0

rejection-class.rule: non-success plus coarse error class; diagnostic wording is not an oracle

request-contract.rule: request file is immutable input; response evaluated by another declared profile

rng-metamorphic.rule: same-candidate clone/replay equality; no cross-fork exact RNG sequence oracle

schema-validity.rule: valid/invalid boolean equal under declared JSON-Schema subset

sse-normalized.rule: incremental UTF-8 decode; data records in order; malformed-count and post-DONE-count exact

state-metamorphic.rule: clone/reset/restore semantics; opaque serialization bytes excluded

state-semantic.rule: continuation and logits equivalence after save/restore
